rule: every distinct forward_direct configuration with a done.flag on the full 70-case test set that run_round9 S1 does not already contain (the 5 exclude-both-phase sanity arms and the 4 AR arms are not included); env = knobs that differ from run_round9.BASE (with config.py's implied POS_ABS_HEAD applied); seeds = the legacy seed list, so each arm pairs per seed with its twin

tiers.how: measured, not chosen (2026-09-20, after the user asked why the tiering did not follow its own criterion). For every configuration's legacy runs: legacy_post_checkpoint_train_drop = median over seeds of (train_loss[best_epoch] - min(train_loss[best_epoch:])) / train_loss[best_epoch], i.e. how much the TRAINING loss still fell in the 150 epochs after the checkpoint the old validation set picked. Validation said stop while training was still moving; the larger this is, the more the old set cut the run short. Calibration on the S1 twins: cgate-ah 12.8% (vs2 moved it +0.03, nothing), w161 11.4%, To-em1200-cgate-ah 25.5% (vs2 took it from 1.53 to 0.89), abs-h128x5 31.4%.
tiers.keep: drop > 12.8% (above the calibrated no-change point) -> stage S1b, default ON: the configurations the old validation set demonstrably stopped early. 90 configs / 1170 runs / ~105 h: the whole abs-model capacity, lookahead, weight and anchor-scale scans of rounds 4-5 (drops 32-56%, best epochs 290-410), the learned gates (33-48%), the round-6 soft gates and floors at 1-6-3 (13-30%), To-ai, os2, the full stack, To-em900.
tiers.archive: drop <= 12.8% -> stage S1c, default OFF: trained at least as long as the winner did, and vs2 did not move the winner. 24 configs / ~44 h: the 1-6-1 gate/flag family (cgate-afb, fip/fiz-cgate-afb, tg10s40, tg20/30, fic), the h192/h256 capacity arms at 1-6-1 and 1-6-3 (best epochs 680-830, many at the 1000 cap), fl20/fl40/fl40s, the shared-channel cgate, To-em1500. Run with --stage S1c to complete the record.
